chunks: And ʿAbdullāh ibn Sinān narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
Inspire them with the love of ʿAlī عليه السلام and leave them simple-minded.

key_terms.أَلْهِمُوهُنَّ: Instill in them or inspire them with something inwardly
key_terms.ذَرُوهُنَّ: Leave them or let them remain
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam ʿAlī ibn Abī Ṭālib عليه السلام

ai.seo_question: What does the hadith say about cultivating love for Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام in women?
ai.summary: This hadith instructs that women should be nurtured upon love for Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام. It also indicates leaving them in simplicity, presenting this as practical ethical guidance within the context of family relations.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4534 - Abdullah ibn Sinan narrated from Abu Abdillah (as) who said:
"Inspire them with the love of Imam Ali ibn Abi Talib (as) and leave them in their natural simplicity."
